recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-50445 follow-up is needed unless the work group later decides to replace the diagram source-of-truth or add a machine-readable diagram representation.
issue_request: FHIR-50445 was an Applied, Persuasive with Modification OO change request for R6 asking that the Device module diagram show DeviceAlert.subject pointing to both Patient and Device. The accepted resolution also clarified that the diagram captures only some key representative relationships and recommends reviewing the respective resources for all valid relationships.
initial_application: The change was applied before this reconciliation by HL7/fhir PR #3836 and commit ff73a37610, which added images/DeviceModule.svg, registered DeviceModule.svg in publish.ini, and changed source/device-module.html from the old PNG and 'the core' wording to the current SVG and representative-relationship wording. Jira comments on FHIR-50445 point to PR #3836 and say the diagram was updated with the FHIR-50439 diagram work.
additional_context: The Device module page is active source linked from the modules pages, and publish.ini includes DeviceModule.svg in the image list used by the build. The DeviceAlert resource definition already allows DeviceAlert.subject to target Patient and Device, among other valid subject types, which matches the relationship the diagram summarizes. FHIR-50439 is the same diagram-change family, while FHIR-50446 shared PR #3836 for adjacent Device module use-case text and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build source already points to the accepted SVG and contains the clarified representative-diagram prose, so another edit would be redundant or would modify only a diagram artifact without a remaining source-level semantic problem.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-50439 supplied the related Device module diagram update referenced by FHIR-50445 and PR #3836, but its Observation-specific diagram claims were not independently decided in this seed commit.
FHIR-50446 shared PR #3836 for adjacent Device module use-case text and already has a combined-branch audit commit.
